apt_src.compile.description: Build source packages after installing or upgrading them. Corresponds to APT::Src::Compile.

apt_src.installdebs.description: Install binary packages after building sources. Implies compile. Corresponds to APT::Src::InstallDebs.

apt_src.patch.description: Try to patch local changes into new source tree when upgrading. Corresponds to APT::Src::Patch.

apt_src.location.description: Directory; only operate on packages in that directory. Corresponds to APT::Src::Location.

apt_src.here.description: Only operate on packages in the current directory. Corresponds to APT::Src::Here.

apt_src.keep_built.description: Do not delete .debs and other built files after installing them. Corresponds to APT::Src::KeepBuilt.

apt_src.no_delete_source.description: Do not delete source files when removing source package. Corresponds to APT::Src::NoDeleteSource.

apt_src.quiet.description: Direct all command output to /dev/null unless a command fails. Corresponds to APT::Src::Quiet.

apt_src.trace.description: Output each command as it is run. Corresponds to APT::Src::Trace.

apt_src.build_command.description: Command to use to build a tree. For non-root users, '-rfakeroot' is appended. Corresponds to APT::Src::BuildCommand.

apt_src.root_command.description: Command used to become root, e.g. to satisfy build-deps. Corresponds to APT::Src::RootCommand.

apt_src.build_deps.description: Controls whether apt-src makes sure a source package's build dependencies are installed. Corresponds to APT::Src::BuildDeps.

apt_src.sources_list.description: List of APT source entries (like /etc/apt/sources.list lines). Each item is a map with keys: type (deb|deb-src), uri, dist, components (optional list of strings). Corresponds to standard apt sources.list format used by apt-src.
